jobs.description:
Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians. 
• Then you take care of a perfect treatment, namely washing, sorting and stocking of the potatoes. 
• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality. 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts. 
• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.

As a logistics operator, you are responsible for monitoring and managing logistics processes, resolving malfunctions, performing technical interventions, and working with modern systems in an automated cold storage environment. You work in a two-shift system and have a technical affinity.What will you be doing at Agristo?As a logistics operator, you are responsible for: 
• Monitoring and managing the processes within the logistics department to ensure continuity. 
• Identifying and resolving irregularities and malfunctions in the logistics flows. 
• Carrying out minor technical interventions to ensure a safe and smooth flow of goods. 
• Working with modern systems and operating cranes and shuttles in the automated cold storage facility. 
• Interpreting data trends and reporting process information with the aim of contributing to improvement actions for the logistics department.
 
• You have a technical affinity. 
• You hold a valid forklift and reach truck certificate, or you are willing to obtain one. 
• Working in a colder environment doesn’t scare you, and you are not afraid of heights. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.). 
• You are comfortable working with computers and eager to learn new programs. 
• You work efficiently and with respect for safety and quality standards. 
• You have a good command of Dutch, French, or English.

Do you enjoy physical work and don't mind working in a cold environment? Are you comfortable working in the meat industry (pork)? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

For our client’s deboning department, we are looking for a motivated employee with experience as a butcher, meat deboner, or within the meat processing industry.Your Profile

• Experience as a butcher, deboner, or within the meat industry is a strong asset.
• You are motivated and enjoy hands-on work.
• You preferably speak and understand at least two of the following languages: Dutch, English, or Polish.
• If you speak one of these languages well, you are also welcome to apply.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.

Your Responsibilities

• Deboning and processing pork products.
• Working according to quality, hygiene, and safety standards.
• Cooperating with colleagues in a production environment.
• Keeping your workplace clean, organized, and safe.

As a quality control associate, you will inspect incoming and outgoing goods. You will verify quantities, record data, and follow up on discrepancies in accordance with established procedures. If you identify damage, incorrect products, or incorrect quantities, you will report them and help find a solution. Your meticulous approach ensures that the quality of the goods and the logistics process are maintained.

 

• You work accurately and have an eye for detail

• You can work independently and take initiative when necessary

• You check and record figures quickly and accurately

• You communicate clearly in the event of damage, incorrect products, or discrepancies in quantities

• You can work according to established procedures

• You are available for a permanent late-shift position

• You are comfortable using a tablet

• You have a very good command of English, as communication with the team leader will be in English

Are you someone who enjoys working with precision and finds satisfaction in quality control? As a quality control associate, you’ll ensure that goods are properly inspected, counted, and recorded. You’ll maintain an overview, quickly identify discrepancies, and make sure everything is correct down to the smallest detail. You’ll work a fixed late shift from 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.

jobs.occupation: Recruitment Consultant I Open to Graduates & Junior Profiles
jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you will help companies identify their future talent while supporting candidates throughout their career journeys. It's a dynamic, entrepreneurial and people-focused role where no two days are the same.

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities
 

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English
• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly?

As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:30 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.  Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment. 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.

An organisation operating in the industrial/manufacturing industry based in Wijnegem. Accessible by car and public transportation.

Jobomschrijving

• Ensure compliance with procurement policies and procedures.
• Collaborate with internal departments to forecast demand and plan supply accordingly.
• Organizing transportation of raw materials and finished goods.

• Handle documentation and administrative tasks related to procurement and supply chain management.

A successful Supply Chain Officer should have:

• A strong understanding of procurement and supply chain processes.
• Experience in the industrial/manufacturing sector is beneficial.
• Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• Professional proficiency in English and French. 
• Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

The company is located in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.

• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.

A successful Finance Officer should have:
